characteristics_identity_caveat: Original run IDENTITY did not separately pin characteristics.py; current published implementation is hashed and saved grids checked exactly.
exactness: HM12Table.moment analytic piecewise integral of declared binary64 linear-ordinate in log(E) and z interpolation, up to floating-point roundoff; not a physical-continuum certificate

units.number_ref: photons per initial-reference cm^3 per s
units.energy_ref: erg per initial-reference cm^3 per s

geometry: FLRW r=0 only; E=q/a_rel and source_ref=a_rel^3 source_proper; all input spectra retain10..50000eV physical source band

provenance.interpolation: linear ordinate in ln(E/eV) and z; native one-sided jumps preserved
provenance.claim: source-bound table intake; exact moments of declared interpolation only

uvb.interpretation: native zeros retained; no log(ordinate), floor, clipping, zero replacement, or extrapolation

provenance.interpolation: linear ordinate in ln(E/eV) and z; native one-sided jumps preserved
provenance.claim: source-bound table intake; exact moments of declared interpolation only

emissivity.interpretation: native zeros retained; no log(ordinate), floor, clipping, zero replacement, or extrapolation

limitations: Source-only errors are independent of the evolved gas and therefore identify an input quadrature error directly.
They do not apportion the evolved Gamma, x, T or heat error among source, initial field, opacity quadrature and nonlinear gas feedback.
No exact cumulative temporal integral is claimed; stored ODE source counters were not repaired or replaced.
Q0 normalizes to exact-reference full-history amplitude for attribution; this does not replace the official fine-grid-amplitude spectral comparison.
HI/HeI/HeII bands are threshold-selected source moments, not cross-section-weighted photoionization or heat integrals.
No floor, clipping, extrapolation, log-ordinate interpolation, or native-cross-section replacement is used.
